Excess is a distortion paired with delay, chorus, or harmonized fifths, inspired by the greatest sounds of the 80s and now available with modern tweaks like independent switching and routing options for your present-day music-making. Controls include: Gain , Tone , and Dist Vol controls for distortion Time , Depth , and Mod Vol controls for modulation Toggle for modulation mode (Delay, Chorus, or Fifth) Toggle to set effect order (Distortion into Modulation, Modulation into Distortion, or both effects in parallel) Expression jack to externally control Rate , Depth , or both Soft-touch bypass footswitches for true bypass and minimal switch noise For more information, see the Excess manual available here . Requires 9V DC center negative 2.1mm jack power supply capable of 125mA (not included).
